**Closing: superseded by the cutover sitting (2026-10-26).**

The Console Pin Gate that this card asked to repair no longer exists. PR B #25827 (merged 2026-10-26 00:07Z, item 6 of #25697) deleted the `console-pin` job and its `console` filter from `ci.yml`, together with `spec-shape-gate.yml` and `prerelease-pin-watch.yml`, and 4a #25745 (merged 2026-10-25 23:29Z) deleted the `.objectui-sha` pin and the console injection scripts the gate ran. The false positive this card measured was a symptom of a pin that is gone: the Console now builds from `ui/apps/console` inside this repository (`pnpm console:build`), and `Build & E2E UI` proves it in the PR that changes it.

Nothing from this card is carried forward. The post-cutover hourly `schedule` CI runs on `main` are read as part of the sitting's step 7 (#25752).

Closed 2026-10-26T00:46Z by the epic PM (#25677 / #25752 sitting).
